name: In-Custody Breakdown by Delivery Man
query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(e.employee_name, ''), b.current_delivery_man) AS employee_name, COUNT(*) AS booklet_count FROM `tabPurisol Coupon Booklet` b LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e ON e.name = b.current_delivery_man WHERE b.status = 'In Custody' AND b.current_delivery_man IS NOT NULL AND b.current_delivery_man != '' GROUP BY b.current_delivery_man, e.employee_name ORDER BY employee_name
